# TS NJM Utils

A TypeScript NPM package that compiles to JavaScript with dual CommonJS/ES module support, providing utility functions for validation, constants, and string manipulation.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @mahendar8121/ts-njm-utils
```

## Usage

### In TypeScript/React (ES Modules)
```typescript
import { isValidEmail, capitalize, APP_NAME } from '@mahendar8121/ts-njm-utils';

console.log(isValidEmail('user@example.com')); // true
console.log(capitalize('hello world')); // Hello world
console.log(APP_NAME); // Enterprise Application
```

### In JavaScript (ES Modules)
```javascript
import { isValidEmail, capitalize, APP_NAME } from '@mahendar8121/ts-njm-utils';

console.log(isValidEmail('user@example.com'));
console.log(capitalize('hello world'));
console.log(APP_NAME);
```

### In JavaScript (CommonJS)
```javascript
const { isValidEmail, capitalize, APP_NAME } = require('@mahendar8121/ts-njm-utils');

console.log(isValidEmail('user@example.com'));
console.log(capitalize('hello world'));
console.log(APP_NAME);
```

## API

### Constants
- `APP_NAME`: string
- `API_TIMEOUT`: number
- `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`: number

### Validation
- `isValidEmail(email: string): boolean`
- `isRequired(value: any): boolean`

### Utils
- `capitalize(value: string): string`

## Compatibility

This package supports:
- ✅ TypeScript projects
- ✅ ES Module JavaScript
- ✅ CommonJS JavaScript
- ✅ Modern Node.js
- ✅ Browsers with module support
- ✅ Bundlers (Webpack, Rollup, Vite, etc.)

## Development

1. Clone the repository
2. Install dependencies: `npm install`
3. Build: `npm run build`
4. Test: `npm test`
5. Publish: `npm publish`
